summary: The no_valid_comparison closure holds. Table S6 reports effects within 34 neuronal subtypes. None covers the registered all-cell, mouse-level contrast. All 50 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes. I verified that the column labeled log2fold_change contains natural-log effects and traced ten GABA6 discrepancies to a barcode pair whose expression profiles switch labels between GEO files. The corrected proposal passed validation.
openIssues: Table S6 counts 1,998 results in its summary and lists 1,865 in detail. The workbook does not explain the difference of 133.
The reviewed sources contain no pooled author estimate for the registered contrast. The historical viewer remains inaccessible, and whole-track concordance remains unassessed.
